verification_policy: Direct research with explicit source-conflict preservation. Do not collapse conflicting acquisition records into a single definitive route without reconciliation.

verification_audit.classification_finding: The current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Super and describes it as a chargeable Ki Blast with three charge levels.
verification_audit.acquisition_conflict: The current Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki page lists Parallel Quest 05 (Saiyan Blood) as the unlock, while the broader Xenoverse Skill Shop reference lists Kamehameha as a 5,000 Zeni Skill Shop item appearing after the Ginyu Force Saga. These sources are retained as a documented conflict rather than silently choosing one route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The researched evidence establishes acquisition routes but does not independently establish a negative Ultimate Finish condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted because they are version-sensitive and were not independently reconciled here.

records.name: Kamehameha
records.unlock_method: Conflicting source records: Parallel Quest 05 — Saiyan Blood; Skill Shop for 5,000 Zeni after Ginyu Force Saga
records.skill_description: The definitive Dragon Ball skill; fires a Ki Blast that can be charged up to level 3.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Kamehameha as a chargeable Ki Blast Super with three charge levels. The same reference lists Goku and multiple customizable partners among notable users. Acquisition evidence is intentionally preserved as conflicting source data pending reconciliation.
